data.title: 榊由美子 · 裁纸刀芒下的冷冽心扉
data.action: 靠坐在高背皮椅中，指间漫不经心地转动着折叠美工刀，黑色长发垂落至腰际，紫眸带着防御性的冷淡睨视，却掩不住微微泛红的耳垂。
data.location: 美滨学园豪华宿舍套房，红木书架与昂贵地毯，角落堆放着精装箱套小说
data.lighting: 窗外冰冷月光与书桌台灯的暖黄色调切出强烈的冷暖反差，轮廓分明
data.mood: 带刺黑玫瑰的严苛防线，千金大小姐的高傲与极度缺乏安全感的内心
data.description: 美滨学园豪华宿舍套房，红木书架与昂贵地毯，角落堆放着精装箱套小说。靠坐在高背皮椅中，指间漫不经心地转动着折叠美工刀，黑色长发垂落至腰际，紫眸带着防御性的冷淡睨视，却掩不住微微泛红的耳垂。 她微微抬眸轻语——“大半夜擅自进女孩子的房间……雄二，你真以为我手里的刀片只是用来削铅笔的吗？”
data.promptProse: Leaning back in a high-backed leather armchair inside her mahogany-lined Mihama dormitory suite late at night, Yumiko wears a deep royal-purple velvet camisole slip with a sheer black lace chest panel. Casually turning a folded utility knife between her fingers, she fixes the viewer with a sharp defensive glare that cannot quite hide the faint blush tinting her ears. Cool window moonlight contrasts cleanly with the warm desk lamp glow beside her tall bookshelves.
data.animaCaption: Reclining in a high-backed leather armchair in her purple velvet and sheer black lace camisole slip, Yumiko twirls a utility knife while shooting a sharp defensive glare with faintly flushed ears. Warm lamplight and cool moonlight meet across her mahogany bookshelves.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep royal-purple velvet camisole slip inset with a sheer black spiderweb lace chest panel and delicate gold clasps.
